name: SEA-RAFT
paper_title: SEA-RAFT: Simple, Efficient, Accurate RAFT for Optical Flow
license_interpretation: BSD-3-Clause is a permissive license: the code and weights can be used in commercial and closed-source products. Redistributions must keep the copyright notice, the license conditions and the disclaimer, and the authors' names may not be used to endorse derived products without permission. An inference subset of the upstream core/ package at commit 9137517b is vendored under libreyolo/models/searaft/_vendor/ with its BSD-3-Clause LICENSE; LibreYOLO's wrapper code is MIT. The weights are the upstream Tartan-C-T-TSKH-spring540x960 S and M checkpoints (MemorySlices on Hugging Face), which upstream publishes without a separate weight license; LibreYOLO mirrors them under the repository's BSD-3-Clause license and states that on the cards. Size l reuses the m weights with 12 refinement iterations instead of 4. No gating; inference only.
